claims: Rick Pitino is the head men's basketball coach at St. John's University.
Rick Pitino was named the 22nd coach in St. John's program history on March 20, 2023.
Pitino led the Red Storm to a Round of 32 appearance in 2026.
Rick Pitino's tenure at St. John's began in 2023.
Rick Pitino signed a six-year contract at St. John's.
Rick Pitino achieved his 900th career victory in February 2026.
Pitino led the team to a top-five seed in the 2025-2026 season.
Pitino led the team to an NCAA Tournament Round of 32 in the 2025-2026 season.
Pitino is a two-time NCAA National Champion with Kentucky and Louisville.
Pitino is a Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame inductee in 2013.
Pitino has previously coached at Kentucky.
